lead_raw_text:
The structure of SrZn₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms (Sr₄Zn₁₂) distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for both Sr and Zn centers: each Sr center has 12 geometric neighbors (4 Sr, 8 Zn), while Zn centers show 12 neighbors with varying Zn and Sr counts. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Zn-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Sr- and Zn-centered 12-vertex polyhedra.
